privacy.metaDescription: What data voidcorp.io collects, why, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: voidcorp.io asks for no account, no form, and sets no cookie. Two kinds of processing run on the site: audience measurement, and session recording only if you accept it.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: VOID CORP, a French single-member limited liability company (EURL) registered with the Créteil Trade and Companies Register under number 848 408 258, with its registered office at 40 rue des Princes de Wagram, 94520 Mandres-les-Roses, France.

audience.title: Audience measurement
audience.body: We use Umami, a cookieless analytics tool, to learn which pages are viewed and which links are clicked. Your IP address is used to derive your country and is not stored.
items: Device type, browser, operating system and language
Country, derived from the IP address
Clicks on key links (projects, social networks, language switch)
audience.basis: Legal basis: our legitimate interest in measuring the site's audience. This processing is strictly limited to audience measurement and exempt from consent.

replays.title: Session recording and heatmaps
replays.body: If you accept, Umami records your visit to show us how the site is used and where it can improve. Only a share of visits is recorded, each capped at a few minutes.
items: Input fields are masked before anything is sent
replays.basis: Legal basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time at the bottom of this page.

storage.title: What is stored on your device
storage.body: No cookie. Your choice about session recording is kept in your browser's local storage for six months, after which you are asked again.

recipients.title: Recipients and processors
recipients.body: Data is never sold or shared for advertising. Only these technical providers can access it:
items: Cloudflare Inc. (United States): delivery network in front of our Umami instance
recipients.transfers: These transfers outside the European Union are covered by the EU - US Data Privacy Framework, which both companies have joined.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Audience data and session recordings are kept for 25 months at most, then deleted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to, restrict and port your data. To exercise them, write to <email>admin@voidcorp.io</email>. We reply within one month.
rights.complaint: If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the <cnil>CNIL</cnil>, the French data protection authority.

settings.title: Your choice
settings.body: Change your answer about session recording here. It takes effect immediately.
